scale.4: Precise, consistent and supported at claimed evidence level

passing_rule: Each applicable criterion >=3 and no critical failure. Report scenario coverage and inspected outputs; pass is not production readiness.
critical_failures: Core business invariant claimed without a viable enforcement mechanism
